dimensions.assessment: Affects residents of the District of Columbia and the office and personnel of the D.C. Attorney General.
dimensions.evidence: The Attorney General for the District of Columbia shall be appointed by the President.

dimensions.assessment: Fundamentally alters how the D.C. Attorney General is selected, removing voter election and immediately terminating the incumbent official.
dimensions.evidence: The term of service of the individual serving as the Attorney General for the District of Columbia on the day before the date of the enactment of this Act shall terminate on the date of the enactment of this Act.

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or revenue effects stated.
Amends the District of Columbia Home Rule Act regarding executive governance of the D.C. Attorney General office.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the District of Columbia Home Rule Act to provide for the appointment of the Attorney General for the District of Columbia by the President

dimensions.assessment: Permanently changes the governance structure of the District of Columbia's top legal office.

missing_information: Any transitional administrative costs or legal challenges associated with terminating the current Attorney General
importance_detail.rationale: This bill changes the District of Columbia Attorney General position from an elected office to a presidential appointment not subject to Senate confirmation, terminating the current Attorney General's term upon enactment.
